summary.zh: 接订阅计费、试用与 Webhook 处理
summary.en: Subscriptions, proration and webhooks with Stripe

description.zh: 接入 Stripe 的订阅与计费：试用、升降级折算、一次性支付、按用量计费、Checkout、客户门户和发票，并处理 Webhook 幂等与签名校验。适合在 Next.js、Express 或 Django 里加付费流程时使用，需要 Stripe 账号与 API 密钥。
description.en: Adds Stripe billing: subscriptions with trials and proration, one-time and usage-based charges, Checkout, customer portal, invoices and idempotent webhook handlers. A Stripe account and API keys are required.
